articles.title: Out-of-Control Truck Triggers Horror Crash Near Gujarat Toll Booth, Tourists Critical
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious road accident was reported near the Saputara–Malegaon Toll Booth in Gujarat’s Dang district after a goods truck allegedly lost control and crashed into a moving Creta car and a tractor.

body.html:
A serious road accident was reported near the Saputara–Malegaon Toll Booth in Gujarat’s Dang district after a goods truck allegedly lost control and crashed into a moving Creta car and a tractor.

According to reports, the truck was travelling from Saputara towards Surat when the driver reportedly lost control of the vehicle and rammed into the Creta car ahead. Due to the impact, the car was pushed into a tractor, leaving the Creta badly damaged.

Several people, including tourists travelling in the Creta and the tractor driver, sustained serious injuries in the accident. Reports said three occupants of the Creta were in critical condition.

The injured were rushed to nearby hospitals for emergency treatment. Further investigation into the incident is underway.

articles.title: “Teen Falls 45 Feet to Death on Zipline”: Agra Adventure Ride Under Scanner After Horror Accident
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 16-year-old boy died after falling nearly 45 feet during a zipline ride at Agra Chaupati in Uttar Pradesh after the pulley lock of the ride allegedly malfunctioned. The tragic incident took place at the adventure zone located in Tajnagri Phase-2 area of Agra.

body.html:
A 16-year-old boy died after falling nearly 45 feet during a zipline ride at Agra Chaupati in Uttar Pradesh after the pulley lock of the ride allegedly malfunctioned.

The tragic incident took place at the adventure zone located in Tajnagri Phase-2 area of Agra.

The deceased was identified as Kunal Agarwal, a Class XI student and resident of Firozabad, who had travelled to Agra with his family for an outing.

According to police, Kunal had visited the Taj Mahal with his parents and younger brother before insisting on trying the zipline attraction while the family was preparing to return home.

Police said the teenager had just begun the ride when the zipline allegedly malfunctioned moments after take-off. CCTV footage reportedly shows Kunal suddenly plunging from the height barely 10 feet away from the starting platform before crashing onto a lower structure and then falling to the ground.

The horrifying incident triggered panic among family members and bystanders, who rushed to rescue him and took him to a nearby hospital. However, doctors declared him dead on arrival.

Kunal’s father, Pankaj Agarwal, a bangles trader from Firozabad, said the family had planned the Agra trip at the request of the children.

“We visited several places, watched a movie, and later went to Agra Chaupati in the evening. Kunal was very excited about the zipline ride. We bought a ₹400 ticket for him. Seconds after he started, we saw him falling,” he said.

The grieving father alleged gross negligence by those operating the zipline and blamed poor safety arrangements for his son’s death.

Based on his complaint, police registered a case under Section 105 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (culpable homicide not amounting to murder) against three persons, including the owner and manager of the zipline operation.

Deputy Commissioner of Police Syed Ali Abbas said two accused — Santosh Kumar Dubey (58) and Abhishek (27) — have been arrested.

Police said preliminary investigation revealed serious lapses in safety measures at the site. Officials stated that the teenager was allegedly not provided a helmet, and no protective net or cushioning had been installed beneath the ride to minimise the impact in case of a fall.

Authorities added that the zipline stretches nearly 100 feet and is suspended at a height of around 45 feet above the ground.

A technical inspection of the equipment is now being carried out as part of the investigation.

articles.title: “Religious Platform Row Sparks Tension”: Police Allegedly Assaulted During Clash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension prevailed in Karnataka’s Bhatkal town after a dispute erupted over the reconstruction of a Hindu religious platform, with some persons allegedly assaulting police personnel during the commotion.

body.html:
Tension prevailed in Karnataka’s Bhatkal town after a dispute erupted over the reconstruction of a Hindu religious platform, with some persons allegedly assaulting police personnel during the commotion.

According to police sources, the incident took place at Jagate Katte in Uttara Kannada district, where a ‘Moori Katte’ religious platform had earlier been removed during National Highway widening works.

Officials said the structure was recently reconstructed on land allegedly under the control of National Highway authorities.

The reconstruction reportedly triggered objections from members of a minority community, who allegedly demanded that the structure be removed.

Police said a group gathered at the spot and allegedly attempted to demolish the reconstructed platform, leading to tension in the area.

During the commotion, police personnel deployed for security were allegedly assaulted while trying to control the crowd and maintain law and order.

Following the incident, additional police forces were rushed to the area, and authorities intensified security arrangements to prevent further escalation.

Officials said the situation is currently under close monitoring.

Police sources confirmed that further investigation into the incident is underway.

articles.title: “Bike Riders Return, Attack Constable”: CCTV Captures Assault on Policeman in Mangaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A police constable was allegedly attacked by a pillion rider on a motorcycle during a late-night vehicle checking operation in Karnataka’s Mangaluru city. The incident took place in the Kodical area in the early hours of Sunday and was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

body.html:
A police constable was allegedly attacked by a pillion rider on a motorcycle during a late-night vehicle checking operation in Karnataka’s Mangaluru city.

The incident took place in the Kodical area in the early hours of Sunday and was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

According to Urwa police, constable Hanumanth Kanti was on duty along with home guard Basavaraj near the Narayan Guru Cooperative Society building to monitor suspicious vehicle movement in the area.

Around 2 am, the officers reportedly signalled a two-wheeler to stop for checking. However, the rider allegedly sped away from the spot.

Police said the motorcycle returned to the same location a few minutes later. During this time, the pillion rider allegedly attacked constable Hanumanth Kanti on the head using a piece of asbestos sheet before the duo fled again.

Despite sustaining injuries, constable Kanti and home guard Basavaraj reportedly attempted to chase and catch the accused, but the assailants managed to escape.

The injured constable was later admitted to a hospital with a minor head injury. Police said he is currently out of danger.

Based on the complaint filed by constable Kanti, Urwa police registered a case against the unidentified accused under Sections 121(1) (voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt to a public servant), 109 (attempt to murder), 132 (assault or criminal force to deter a public servant from discharging duty), and 3(5) (common intention) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

Police said efforts are underway to identify and trace the accused using CCTV footage and other evidence.

Further investigation is underway.

#Mangaluru #Karnataka #BreakingNews #IndiaNews #ViralVideo

articles.title: “10 Days After Childbirth, Woman Shot Dead”: UP Man Kills Father and Wife Over Suspected Affair
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking double murder case has been reported from Uttar Pradesh’s Bulandshahr district, where a 26-year-old man allegedly shot dead his father and wife using a licensed pistol over suspicion of an illicit relationship between them.

body.html:
A shocking double murder case has been reported from Uttar Pradesh’s Bulandshahr district, where a 26-year-old man allegedly shot dead his father and wife using a licensed pistol over suspicion of an illicit relationship between them.

The incident took place on Sunday in Kalandargarhi village under the Khurja Nagar Kotwali area, around 22 kilometres from the district headquarters.

According to police, the accused, identified as Mobin alias Momin, allegedly fired at his father Riyazuddin’s temple and then shot his wife Sana in the chest and stomach before fleeing the scene.

Both victims were found lying in pools of blood inside the house. Family members and police rushed them to hospital, where doctors declared them dead.

Police said Mobin had married Sana around a year ago, and the couple had recently welcomed a baby boy just 10 days ago.

Senior Superintendent of Police Dinesh Kumar Singh said preliminary investigation revealed that the accused suspected his father and wife of having an illicit relationship, which allegedly led to repeated disputes within the family.

“A person named Momin shot his father Riyazuddin and his wife Sana using his father’s licensed pistol. He suspected that his father had an illicit relationship with his wife. There had been several arguments over this issue earlier,” the SSP said.

After the murders, the accused allegedly fled the spot. However, police teams tracked him using CCTV footage and surveillance inputs.

SP Rural Antariksh Jain said the accused was arrested around one-and-a-half kilometres away from his house after a search operation.

Police have taken the accused into custody and are currently interrogating him.

Further investigation is underway.

#Bulandshahr #UttarPradesh #DoubleMurder #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Moradabad Woman, Lover and Sister Arrested for Husband’s Alleged Murder
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case has come to light from Uttar Pradesh’s Moradabad, where a woman allegedly conspired with her lover, her younger sister, and another man to kill her husband and stage the death as a s***.

body.html:
A shocking murder case has come to light from Uttar Pradesh’s Moradabad, where a woman allegedly conspired with her lover, her younger sister, and another man to kill her husband and stage the death as a s***.

Police said the accused woman allegedly electrocuted her husband to death and later forcibly administered po**on to make the murder appear like a s*** case.

The incident was reported from the Kundanpur area under Majhola police station limits.

The deceased was identified as Pawan Thakur, an employee in the agriculture department and a resident of Moradabad. He originally belonged to Baghi Godhanpur village in the Mainather area.

According to police, Pawan married Aanchal, a resident of Sambhal district, in 2020. The couple had a two-year-old daughter.

Investigators said Aanchal allegedly developed a relationship two years ago with Ankit, the son of Pawan’s cousin. Pawan reportedly came to know about the affair nearly six months ago, leading to frequent disputes within the family.

Police said Aanchal’s younger sister Shikha was also allegedly involved in a relationship with Ajay Diwakar, a resident of Majhola. Shikha had reportedly been staying at Aanchal’s house for several months.

According to the investigation, the four accused allegedly hatched a conspiracy to eliminate Pawan.

Police said that when Pawan returned home from work on Friday evening, Aanchal allegedly started an argument as part of the plan. Investigators claim the accused then tied Pawan’s hands and legs before giving him electric shocks.

To make the death look like s*****, the accused allegedly forced po***n into his mouth after electrocuting him.

The next day, Aanchal informed Pawan’s sisters that his condition was serious. He was rushed to hospital, where doctors declared him dead.

Initially, Aanchal allegedly told police that her husband died by s**** after consuming p***on. However, the post-mortem report reportedly revealed that the actual cause of death was electric shock. Doctors also found nine injury marks on the body, deepening suspicion.

During interrogation, Aanchal allegedly confessed to the crime, following which police detained all four accused — Aanchal, Ankit, Shikha, and Ajay Diwakar.

Police also said Pawan had earlier expressed fear to his sisters that he could be murdered someday and had reportedly told them not to believe it if his death was shown as s****. His sisters later handed over an audio recording of the conversation to police.

SP City Ran Vijay Singh confirmed the arrests and said further investigation is underway.

#Moradabad #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #MurderCase #BreakingNews

articles.title: Hyderabad Police Crack Down on Reckless Racers Near Niloufer Cafe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chaos unfolded near Niloufer Cafe in Hyderabad’s Madhapur area after groups of youths allegedly turned city roads into an illegal racing track during the weekend, forcing police to launch a late-night crackdown.

body.html:
Chaos unfolded near Niloufer Cafe in Hyderabad’s Madhapur area after groups of youths allegedly turned city roads into an illegal racing track during the weekend, forcing police to launch a late-night crackdown.

According to police, several youngsters were involved in dangerous car and bike racing near the popular cafe area late at night, ignoring repeated warnings issued by patrolling officers.

Officials said the racers allegedly refused to stop their vehicles despite police instructions and reportedly drove aggressively even towards policemen attempting to intercept them.

The situation escalated as police teams chased multiple vehicles through the area after the accused allegedly tried to flee.

Videos circulating on social media reportedly show police stopping vehicles, breaking car windows in some cases to pull out the occupants, and using mild force to bring the situation under control.

Several persons were taken into custody for questioning over their alleged involvement in illegal racing and reckless driving activities.

Police said weekend midnight racing continues to remain a serious concern in Hyderabad, with stunt riders and racers frequently creating panic and posing major safety risks on city roads during late-night hours.

The Madhapur area has reportedly become one of the hotspots for such illegal racing activities, especially during weekends when traffic movement is relatively low.

Authorities said strict action would be taken against those involved in dangerous stunts, overspeeding, and violation of traffic regulations.

The latest incident near Niloufer Cafe has once again highlighted growing concerns over illegal street racing and reckless driving in Hyderabad.

Further investigation is underway.

#Hyderabad #Madhapur #StreetRacing #NilouferCafe

articles.title: Man Arrested for Allegedly Molesting Woman Carrying Child in Hyderabad’s Alkapur Township
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Narsingi Police have arrested a 26-year-old man in connection with a molestation case reported from Hyderabad’s Alkapur Township after CCTV footage of the incident went viral on social media.

body.html:
The Narsingi Police have arrested a 26-year-old man in connection with a molestation case reported from Hyderabad’s Alkapur Township after CCTV footage of the incident went viral on social media.

The accused was identified as Vadde Nagaraju, a resident of Puppalguda and a native of Mahabubnagar district.

According to police, the incident took place around 1:44 pm on May 14 near Pranati Easha Apartment on Road No. 4 in Alkapuri Township, under the Narsingi police station limits.

Police said the woman was returning home after picking up her two-and-a-half-year-old child from a nearby playschool when the accused allegedly followed her from the main road.

The CCTV footage reportedly shows the accused approaching the woman from behind while she was carrying the child, allegedly pulling her dress and behaving indecently before fleeing the spot.

The woman is later seen turning around and attempting to chase the accused after raising an alarm.

The video quickly spread across social media platforms, triggering outrage and fresh concerns over women’s safety in residential areas.

Following the incident, the victim lodged a complaint on May 19, after which police registered a case under Sections 78 and 79 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

Special police teams were formed to identify and trace the accused. Police later apprehended Nagaraju within a few days of the incident.

According to investigators, preliminary verification showed that the accused had no previous criminal record and was not previously involved in similar offences.

Further investigation is underway.

#Hyderabad #CCTV #ViralVideo #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Water Tanker Turns Turtle”: CCTV Captures Dramatic Accident in Kerala’s Thrissur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A panchayat-owned drinking water tanker overturned on the roadside in Kerala’s Thrissur district after the driver reportedly lost control of the vehicle, narrowly avoiding a major tragedy.

body.html:
A panchayat-owned drinking water tanker overturned on the roadside in Kerala’s Thrissur district after the driver reportedly lost control of the vehicle, narrowly avoiding a major tragedy.

The incident took place in the Erumappetti-Kuttanchery-Nellikunnu area and was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. The footage has since gone viral on social media.

According to preliminary reports, the tanker suddenly went out of control while moving along the road and toppled onto its side.

Authorities suspect that overspeeding or a possible technical malfunction may have contributed to the accident. However, the exact cause of the mishap has not yet been confirmed.

Fortunately, no deaths or serious injuries were reported in the incident.

Local residents said a major disaster was narrowly averted, as the tanker could have caused severe damage if it had crashed into nearby buildings, vehicles, or pedestrians.

Police officials reached the spot soon after receiving information and carried out a preliminary inspection of the accident site.

Authorities have launched an investigation to determine the exact reason behind the crash and whether negligence on the part of the driver was involved.

#Thrissur #Kerala #CCTV #ViralVideo #BreakingNews #WaterTanker

articles.title: Temple Elephant Runs Amok, Damages Vehicles and Houses
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic gripped parts of Kerala’s Thrissur district on Saturday after a temple elephant went on a rampage, damaging vehicles and houses and even flipping a moving car with a woman trapped inside.

body.html:
Panic gripped parts of Kerala’s Thrissur district on Saturday after a temple elephant went on a rampage, damaging vehicles and houses and even flipping a moving car with a woman trapped inside.

The elephant, identified as Shivalakshmi Ayyappan, reportedly turned violent near the South Gopuram entrance of the Vadakkumnathan Temple while being stopped for photography.

According to police, the elephant ran amok from Kattapparam in Peringavu, moved through Palace Road, and later entered Gandhi Nagar Street — a densely populated residential area with nearly 300 houses.

Authorities said the elephant damaged around six cars and the compound walls of two houses during the rampage.

One of the most shocking moments occurred when the elephant allegedly lifted and overturned a moving car. The woman inside the vehicle was rescued safely by local residents.

Eyewitnesses said the elephant was moving without a mahout when people realised something was wrong.

“A moving car was flipped by the elephant and people inside got trapped. We somehow managed to pull them out safely,” a local resident said.

The driver of the overturned car, identified as Sangeetha, said she was heading to work when people on a scooter warned her about the elephant approaching the area.

She said her daughter was travelling behind her on a scooter, and while trying to alert her by honking and asking her to turn back, the elephant suddenly attacked the vehicle.

“The elephant lifted my car and overturned it. I got trapped inside before people rescued me. I am still in shock,” she said.

According to Viyyur police, officials received information about the incident around 9:15 am. Police personnel, forest officials and the elephant control squad rushed to the area and later managed to restrain the animal by chaining it to a wall.

Thrissur Mayor Niji Justin said the elephant has been brought under temporary control and discussions are underway regarding its safe transportation. She also stated that the elephant sustained injuries to its ears and limbs during the incident.

Meanwhile, tension briefly erupted between local residents and media personnel covering the incident. Some residents objected to visuals of the elephant being recorded and broadcast, claiming it could affect the animal’s chances of being hired for temple festivals in the future.

During the confrontation, a cameraperson reportedly sustained minor injuries after equipment was hit.

Fortunately, no major injuries or deaths were reported in the incident.

#Thrissur #Kerala #ElephantRampage #BreakingNews
